R-hierarchy.reason: The 24:18 elapsed time dominates the center, the progress ring frames it, and the filled pause button reads as the main action with the outlined end button secondary.

R-controls.reason: Pause and end are distinct round/pill buttons in a pair, and the dialog's cancel and confirm are each clear standalone buttons.

R-text.reason: No text is clipped or overlapping in any render; the dialog body wraps cleanly onto two lines.

R-wear-round.reason: All text, metrics, and buttons sit within the circle on both sizes, with the time and distance tucked inside the narrow top and the buttons clear of the bottom curve.

R-wear-glance.reason: One idea (run in progress) with a hero time, three supporting values, and just two actions reads at a glance.

R-wear-hero.reason: 24:18 is set in a large display-style numeral, far bigger than every other element, and the secondary text stays readable.

R-wear-sizes.reason: The small render is complete and uncramped, and the large render keeps everything and adds a '1.9 km to go' line with pill-shaped buttons without breaking.

R-wear-color.reason: Black background, with primary color limited to the progress arc and the pause/confirm buttons; the coral stop icon and heart are status accents, and the secondary buttons use neutral/outlined containers.

R-workout-hero.reason: On the run renders 24:18 is clearly the largest element, and distance, heart rate, and pace are all shown in smaller, uncrowded rows.
